section.heading: Civil action for deprivation of rights

level.content: Every person who, under color of any statute, ordinance, regulation, custom, or usage, subjects, or causes to be subjected, any citizen of the United States to the deprivation of any rights, privileges, or immunities secured by the Constitution and laws, shall be liable to the party injured.

note.heading: Amendments
note.content: 2002 — Pub. L. 107–273 substituted "Department of Agriculture" for "Department of Agriculture".

level.content: Body text of the second section.
